content.value: JavaScript handles user input, state updates, and interactions. Start with primitives, objects, arrays, and expressions. Build logic carefully with strict checks and clear naming so your UI behavior stays predictable as features grow.

concepts.name: JavaScript variable
concepts.description: A named reference to a value in JavaScript code.

concepts.name: let
concepts.description: A JavaScript keyword for declaring a block-scoped variable that can be reassigned.

concepts.name: const
concepts.description: A JavaScript keyword for declaring a block-scoped variable binding that cannot be reassigned.

concepts.name: Primitive type
concepts.description: A basic JavaScript value type such as string, number, boolean, null, undefined, symbol, or bigint.

concepts.name: Expression
concepts.description: Code that evaluates to a value, such as a calculation, variable reference, or function call.

concepts.name: Operator
concepts.description: A symbol or keyword that performs an operation on values, such as arithmetic, comparison, or logic.
